title: Three's Company (saga)
start: Find a bear pelt while raiding the 1-11 frozen floors of Daemonheim, then ask Skaldrun south-west of the Daemonheim entrance to share their story.
prereq_other: Find and free Skaldrun from the frozen floors in Daemonheim

items.t: Ring of kinship to find the bear pelt

recommended.t: Persistent Rage relic power, for quick and unlimited healing with Regenerate

rewards.t: Abridged: An abridged book, which when read gives:
Unabridged: For 100% score (all of the secondary objectives), as well as the abridged book reward, an unabridged book, which when read gives:
3,750 experience in Attack, Ranged or Magic.

steps.t: Head to Daemonheim and bank everything, including your ring of kinship.

Right-click choose start saga on Skaldrun, choose the first option then Play Saga. (Note: If you found the bear skin a long time ago and forgot about it, there is a chance this is bugged.. You are best off talking to Skaldrun manually and asking about the bearskin and to tell you the story. This is how you know you've found it already and can start the saga)
p: Smelly and worn. Skaldrun might want to look at this.
The dungeon map for the Three's Company saga

steps.t: Control Ariane, pick up the dusk eels from the tables.
As Ariane, enter the south door, kill all the enemies and pick up the dusk eels.
Pick up the gold charm and heim crabs but do not eat them.
Control Sir Owen and check the rocky debris for a novite ore.
Enter the south door.
Control Ozan and unlock the door by stepping on each of the 4 pressure plates.

sub.t: The puzzle is different for everyone and every time.

steps.t: Open the east door.
Quickly switch to Ariane once in the next room.

As Ariane, kill all the enemies. (Make sure you select earth strike in your magic book, it won't show properly but Ariane is lower level despite the spells that show up probably due to your character being higher level.)
As Ariane, make a cub skinweaver by using the gold charm on the summoning obelisk.
As Ariane, talk to the cub skinweaver.
Enter the east door.
As Ariane, flip all tiles until all yellow or green.

sub.t: You can right click "force" to flip individual tiles.

steps.t: As Ariane, enter the north door, quickly pick up the green rectangle key, and exit the room.
Switch to Ozan and return to the starting room without teleporting (west, west, north, north).

sub.t: There is currently a bug where if you use Home Teleport, it will turn the character you are currently controlling into your player character and you'll no longer be able to switch to other characters or continue on. You'll be forced to restart the Saga from last checkpoint.

steps.t: Switch to Ariane.
Unlock the green rectangle door and enter.
"Wait" on each of the pressure pads for Owen and Ozan.
Enter the south door.
Take the crimson triangle key.
Right-click "Get-premonition" on any strange crystal.
Touch the following crystals in order:
Enter the north door.
Right-click call Owen and Ozan to walk them off the pressure plates.
p: Sir Owen poking around the rubble

steps.t: Enter the west door.
As Ariane, unlock the crimson triangle door and enter it.
As Ariane, kill all the enemies and pick up the dusk eels.
Control Ozan, and enter the east door.

As Ozan, talk to the guard. [Chat: 1 [Charm] What are you guarding? › 2 Isn't guarding a door in these dungeons a little...redundant? › 1 Who put you up to guarding the door? › 2 Why are you bothering to guard it?]
p: The guard happily harvesting his potatoes.

steps.t: Enter the east door.
Control Owen and push the statues into place.

sub.t: The four southern statues should match the position of the statues in the north.

steps.t: Enter the east door and pick up the fractite pickaxe.
Return west to the guard room and mine the zephyrium rock hidden behind the northwest pillar.
Return east to the statue room.
Control Ozan and enter the northern door.
Proceed through the traps and investigate the broken longsword.
Control Ariane and return to the previous room.
Enter the southern door, kill the enemies and pick up the dusk eel.
Enter the east door and pick up the gold crescent key.
Talk to Pikkupstix (in the northwest corner of the room). [Chat: 3 Can you walk? › 1 You should head to the surface now. › 4 Leave]
Return to the room north of the starting room without teleporting (west, north, west, west).
Unlock the gold crescent door north of the starting room.
Enter the room and continue through the dialogue. [Chat: 1 Sir Owen › 2 Ozan › 3 Ariane]
Kill the two arctic bears and then kill Carn.
Once he is killed, choose any chat option.
